resources.string: RailBook me journey select karein, phir Continue to IRCTC.
IRCTC open · From/To/Date/Class + passengers auto-fill · Search khud chalega · class chip pehle refresh (⟳) phir select · Book Now khud tap → passenger form · Login/OTP/Pay aap karenge.
IRCTC ki security (Akamai) ne app ka in-app browser block kar diya. Details clipboard par copy ho gayi — official IRCTC app/browser khul raha hai, wahan sirf paste karein.
Official IRCTC app khula · wahan auto-fill nahi hota (OS rule) — summary clipboard me copy hai, paste/type karo.
IRCTC app install nahi hai · normal tap se auto-fill wala website khulega.
App sirf class chip ka Refresh (⟳), Search aur Book Now (passenger form tak) khud dabati hai — Login, OTP, CAPTCHA aur Payment kabhi auto nahi.
Aapki details IRCTC par khud bhar jaayengi — jo yahan bhara hai wo dobara daalne ki zaroorat nahi. Sirf login/OTP/payment aap karenge.
